# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen-year-old  <sub>[v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c4 P18](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0018)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nell with an E  <sub>[v1 c12 P17](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell has thick, wavy red hair, though she once mistakenly dyed it green. She has a delicate white hand and seven prominent freckles on her nose, which she once tried to remove using a magazine formula lotion.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P18](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0018), [v1 c27 P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028), [v2 c20 P17](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0017), [v2 c20 P19](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0019), [v2 c20 P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v3 c1 P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027)_

## Personality

Nell is a talkative, deeply imaginative, and principled young woman who values friendship and affection over corporal punishment. She possesses strong literary ambitions and experiences deep emotional immersion in stories and natural beauty, though she occasionally struggles with self-awareness and chatters excessively.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P13](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0013), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c4 P18](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0018), [v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020), [v3 c1 P26](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0026), [v3 c1 P29](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0029), [v3 c36 P13](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0013)_

## History

After moving to Grey Shutters, Nell made a lifelong pact of friendship with Isolde Pembroke in the Pembroke garden. During her school days, she was disciplined by Miss Thorne for secretly reading Ben Hur during Canadian history class, prompting her to promise to avoid foolish novels. When Miss Thorne offered her a place in a preparation class for Regent's entrance exam, Nell eagerly pursued her dream to become a schoolteacher. At Regent's Academy, she was a top contender for the academic medal alongside Hugh Carrow and Penrose Wilson, forming close friendships with Mabel Colby and Honora Hollis. Upon becoming a teacher, Nell firmly resolved never to use physical punishment, striving instead to guide her pupils with kindness and cultivate their inherent goodness as taught by Professor Rennie. Later, she achieved her first literary success when The Youth's Friend accepted a sketch she submitted, earning a ten-dollar check.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c4 P18](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0018), [v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 c36 P5](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0005)_

## Quotes

> Thank you ma’am, my physical health is fine, even if my mood is quite disheveled  <sub>[v1 c12 P20](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0020)</sub>

> I could never strike a youngster. I do not support it whatsoever.  <sub>[v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

> I would prefer that my students affectionally regard me and remember me in future years as a genuine benefactor instead of being listed on the honor roll  <sub>[v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020)</sub>

> I feel terrified of speaking or making a move because I dread that this entire magnificent beauty might disappear like silence being shattered  <sub>[v3 c1 P26](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0026)</sub>

> A short piece I transmitted to The Youth’s Friend two weeks back has been taken by them  <sub>[v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003)</sub>
